question.purpose: The interview question, set as an editorial standfirst. Only large type on the page; streams in token by token.

wordmark.purpose: The chrysalyst wordmark in the topbar; the only serif UI element.

body.purpose: Typed answer text; line-height locks to the 1.75rem writing baseline inside the field.

caption.purpose: Inline error message body — the one place copy is set below 1rem.

action.purpose: The submit control label; semibold, lightly tracked, sentence case.

label.purpose: All 11px uppercase tracked micro-labels and status lines.

motion.name: cursor-blink
motion.purpose: Hard on/off blink of the 2px streaming cursor rule. No fade. Removed under prefers-reduced-motion and frozen static in the failed state.

motion.name: confirm-in
motion.purpose: Opacity fade from 0 on the recorded confirmation line — the single authored accent beat. Removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Topbar
components.description: Ruled masthead: mark plus wordmark on the left, tracked metadata line on the right.
components.html: chrysalystInterview · 01
components.css: .ds-topbar { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 1rem; max-width: 40rem; margin: 0 auto; padding-bottom: 0.75rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); } .ds-topbar-wordmark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 1.0625rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.01em; color: var(--ink); } .ds-topbar-mark { display: block; flex: none; width: 15px; height: 15px; color: var(--ink); } .ds-topbar-meta { font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; color: var(--ink-soft); }

components.name: Question Standfirst
components.description: The editorial centrepiece: an 11px tracked kicker above a large serif question that streams in with a trailing cursor rule.
components.html:
The question

What problem does your product solve

the question is still being written
components.css: .ds-kicker { margin: 0 0 1rem; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-soft); } .ds-question { margin: 0; font-family: var(--serif); font-size: 1.75rem; line-height: 1.32; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: -0.003em; color: var(--ink); } .ds-note { margin: 0.85rem 0 0; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-soft); }

components.name: Streaming Cursor Rule
components.description: The anti-chatbot streaming signal: one 2px hairline blinking hard on/off. Static in the failed state, removed under reduced motion.
components.css: .ds-cursor-rule { display: inline-block; width: 0.62em; height: 2px; margin-left: 0.12em; vertical-align: 0.16em; background: var(--ink); animation: ds-cursor-blink 1.05s steps(1, end) infinite; } @keyframes ds-cursor-blink { 50% { opacity: 0; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-cursor-rule { animation: none; } }

components.name: Ruled Answer Field
components.description: A sheet of ruled writing paper: underline rules only, no box, typed text sitting on a 1.75rem baseline. Focus turns the baseline rule vermilion.
components.css: .ds-answer-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 0.65rem; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-soft); } .ds-answer-field { display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 5.25rem; padding: 0.35rem 0 0.5rem; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 0; background-color: transparent; background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 0, transparent calc(1.75rem - 1px), var(--rule) calc(1.75rem - 1px), var(--rule) 1.75rem); background-position: 0 0.35rem; font-family: var(--grotesque); font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.75rem; color: var(--ink); resize: none; } .ds-answer-field:focus { outline: none; border-bottom-color: var(--accent); } .ds-answer-field:disabled { opacity: 0.55; }

components.name: Record Submit Control
components.description: A right-aligned text link that submits; no button chrome. Vermilion when active, warm grey when disabled.
components.html: One question this round.
components.css: .ds-actions { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 1.5rem; margin-top: 1rem; } .ds-hint { margin-right: auto; font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--ink-soft); } .ds-submit { padding: 0.35rem 0; border: 0; background: none; font-family: var(--grotesque); font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: var(--accent); cursor: pointer; } .ds-submit:disabled { color: #a7a299; cursor: default; } .ds-submit:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Recorded Confirmation
components.description: A quiet one-line receipt in vermilion above a vermilion hairline; fades in once over 0.45s.
components.html: Recorded — saved to this session
components.css: .ds-confirm { margin-top: 1.25rem; padding-top: 1rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--accent); font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--accent); animation: ds-confirm-in 0.45s ease-out; } @keyframes ds-confirm-in { from { opacity: 0; } to { opacity: 1; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-confirm { animation: none; } }

components.name: Inline Error
components.description: The stream broke, said in place: a hidden vermilion label and an ink message behind a 2px vermilion left rule. Replaces the answer block, never overlays.
components.html:
The question stopped

Cannot reach the language model. Check that Ollama is running, then reload.
components.css: .ds-error { margin-top: 2.5rem; padding-top: 1.5rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); } .ds-error-body { padding-left: 0.9rem; border-left: 2px solid var(--accent); } .ds-error-label { display: block; margin: 0 0 0.4rem; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--accent); } .ds-error-message { margin: 0; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--ink); }

narrative.overview: chrysalyst's browser client is a magazine page that happens to be interactive. One question is set like an editorial standfirst — serif, large, unhurried — and answered in a ruled column below it. There is no chat thread and no wizard chrome. Hairline rules and tracked uppercase micro-labels do all the structural work; whitespace does the rest. The register is Monocle / Apartamento / Études: warm paper, near-black ink, and a single editorial vermilion spent only on the few marks that must be noticed. The system is flat — no card, no shadow, square corners. Depth is 1px rules and air. The one place ink gives way to colour is a state change: a focused field, a completed save, a broken stream. Density is low; the composition is a single centred ~40rem column with generous outer margin and no responsive breakpoints.
keyCharacteristics: One serif voice for the question, one grotesque voice for everything else.
Structure is rules and space — never boxes, never shadow.
Vermilion is a state signal, not a brand wash.
Uppercase tracked micro-labels (0.16em) annotate every region.
A single ~40rem column, centred, with no responsive breakpoints.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Vermilion appears on at most one element per state. If a second thing on screen is red, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The No-Box Rule
rules.body: Content is separated by rules and space only. A background fill, a border on more than one side, or a rounded container is a violation of the world.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Serif is the question and the wordmark — nothing else. Everything a user operates or reads as interface is Libre Franklin.

rules.name: The Tracked-Label Rule
rules.body: Any label at 11px is uppercase and tracked 0.16em. Never track body or question text positive; the question carries a slight negative track (-0.003em).

rules.name: The Flat-Forever Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never leave the page plane. If a block needs to feel separate, add a hairline rule and more space above it — not a shadow, not a fill.

dos: Do keep every surface on the warm paper ground (#f4f1ea) with no fill, no card, no shadow — structure with 1px hairline rules (#d8d2c4) and space.
Do set questions and only questions (plus the wordmark) in Source Serif 4; everything operable or informational is Libre Franklin.
Do spend vermilion (#c8402b) on exactly one element per state: the submit control, the focused field rule, the confirmation, or the error mark.
Do track 11px labels uppercase at 0.16em; keep the column at the 40rem measure, centred.
Do gate every animation behind prefers-reduced-motion, and give any motion-only status a visible text equivalent.
Do write error copy that names the failure and the recovery step.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent hue, a gradient, or tinted text — secondary text is Soft Ink (#55524b) only.
Don't add border-radius above the 2px ceiling, and prefer 0.
Don't wrap content in a bordered or filled box, or add a box-shadow.
Don't use bouncing dots or a spinner for streaming — the streaming signal is the single blinking 2px rule.
Don't widen the measure past 40rem or left-align the column.
